# Source and component terms

This is an attributed copy of five Kaggle datasets published by Ahmed Berat
Özer. Each original card marks the Kaggle dataset licence as **Other**;
the files are not collectively relicensed by this copy. Consult the
original cards and the competition rules before reuse beyond this
non-commercial competition setting.

- [CASMI26 competition data and rules](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/enveda-CASMI26-molecule-id-mass-spectra/rules):
  the `v2_pool/`, `v3_models/` and `v4b/` source cards identify derivatives
  of competition training data containing CC BY-NC components. Preserve
  attribution and non-commercial restrictions on those components.
- [COCONUT](https://coconut.naturalproducts.net/): the same source cards
  identify COCONUT-derived pool data as CC BY 4.0.
- [DreaMS](https://github.com/roman-bushuiev/DreaMS): `v4b/LICENSE-NOTICE.txt`
  attributes the `fe_D.pt` descendant and code, with MIT / CC BY 4.0 terms.
- [NCBI PubChem downloads](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/docs/downloads):
  `pubchem_tier/` is a prepared PubChem-derived structure subset. PubChem
  says most data can be downloaded but contributor-specific restrictions
  can apply; the source card uses **Other**, so this package makes no blanket
  CC0 claim for these three arrays.
- [ms-pred / ICEBERG](https://github.com/coleygroup/ms-pred):
  `iceberg/LICENSE-NOTICE.txt` attributes the ms-pred inference subset
  (MIT), published MassSpecGym-trained weights, pure-torch shims, and
  bundled wheel terms (RDKit BSD-3-Clause, Lightning packages Apache 2.0,
  einops MIT). The original license text remains in `iceberg/src/ms_pred/LICENSE`.
- [The v4g notebook](https://www.kaggle.com/code/ahmedberatozer/casmi26-v4g-inference)
  identifies its *notebook code* as Apache 2.0. That code licence does not
  supersede the separate data/model/component terms above.

The exact original names, content hashes and sizes are in `MANIFEST.json`.
